headline: Walked the studio's own #1 CTA for the first time in 11 sessions and found the flagship game pages telling visitors a live game was 'coming soon' — fixed the lying surface, fused play into the membership funnel, and made every game's share snippet whole.

items.title: SPARKED game pages no longer contradict themselves with a stale 'Demo Coming Soon'
items.insight: Both live titles carried a 'Demo Coming Soon' section that directly contradicted their own working 'Play Now' hero links — a CANON-031 lying surface on the studio's flagship conversion-and-share pages, missed for 11 sessions because the audits trusted the registry's 'Live & Playable' label instead of clicking through. Replaced both with live Play panels and shipped a coherence gate so a SPARKED page can never silently claim 'coming soon' again. The deeper 4-surface root cause (a single-source game registry) is deferred to its own session; the gate is the interim guard.
items.evidence: check-game-playability-coherence.mjs 7/7 self-test, folded into check-proof-surface (12 game pages coherent, 0 warnings); commit d4d194f6

items.title: Fused the play moment into the membership funnel
items.insight: The games are the traffic magnet but handed every visitor to an external build with no capture, on a site whose SOUL says membership is the load-bearing thing. Each new Play panel now pairs the play CTA with a 'save your progress / track your franchise — join free' ask at the exact moment of intent, instrumented as a bounded funnel:* beacon so the play-to-join bridge is measurable once traffic accrues.
items.evidence: funnel-tracking.js loaded on both SPARKED pages; game_play_click / game_join_from_play emit to /v/rum; check-rum-allowlist in sync (23 allowlisted / 19 emit)

items.title: Made every game's search/social/AI snippet a whole sentence
items.insight: Seven game pages plus the games index shipped 201-258-char meta descriptions that truncate mid-sentence in Google, Discord, and AI-answer unfurls — the prime share surface for a studio whose thesis is 'a shared link sells the studio', cut off at the knees. Rewrote all 13 flagged pages to SERP-safe lengths and added a tighter 160-char ceiling for game pages so the conversion surface can't regress.
items.evidence: check-meta-descriptions 0 length warnings (was 10), self-test 10/10 incl. game-page ceiling; commit 69a175e0

followUps: Prod-verify the S195+S196+S197 wave on a real browser (game Play panels, bespoke OG cards, journal collection schema, Ask IGNIS multi-turn)
GAME-REGISTRY SINGLE-SOURCE (item 1 L3) — data/game-registry.json across the 4 status surfaces, ~6h, its own session

honestyLedger.title: journal-looks-abandoned-fix
honestyLedger.why: DISPROVEN on verification — journal/index.html already renders a live journal-feed.js beside the curated entries; the surface is not abandoned. Freshness is a founder-gated content-publish decision (SOUL: no auto-publish), not a code gap.

honestyLedger.title: aeo-qa-content-page
honestyLedger.why: Speculative on a data-starved site — oracle-queries.json is curated seed chips, not captured intent, and FAQPage schema already ships sitewide. Net-new Q&A content is low-confidence ROI until real query data exists.

honestyLedger.title: more-funnel-instrumentation
honestyLedger.why: Refused — S186-S196 over-built the apparatus on a funnel at ~1 event/30d; adding more measurement before fixing the broken conversion path would compound the imbalance.

honestyLedger.title: game-play-dead-end-fix headline framing
honestyLedger.why: Corrected DOWN during implement — the audit said 'the #1 CTA dead-ends on a placeholder', but the hero already linked the live build; the real bug was a self-contradicting section, not a hard dead-end. Fewer, truer claims.
